It stays constant across a month with unpaid leave or a mid-month hire, whereas SueldoTrabajado (NIE070) moves. Never below 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905 in 2026) for a full-time employee.

fields.finding: The client computes TiempoLaborado as CALENDAR days from 'Hire Date' to the settlement end, both included, as an integer without decimals (261 of 261; e.g. hire 2001-01-01 -> 9404). The draft requires the commercial-year construction of annex s.8.3.1 (360-day year, 30-day month) with 2 decimals, which gives about 9270.00 for the same employee. fields.proposed_explanation:
COMPOSITE VALUE - construction rule. Cumulative service with the employer expressed in DAYS on the Colombian commercial-year convention fixed by Technical Annex s.8.3.1: 1 year = 360 days, 1 month = 30 days. The annex's own worked example is 5 years + 3 months + 18 days = (5 x 360) + (3 x 30) + 18 = 1908.00. Sub-fields: [years x 360] + [months x 30] + [odd days]. PERSISTENCE: recomputed every month from FechaIngreso (NIE002) to the settlement end; it is cumulative service, NOT days worked in the period (that is DiasTrabajados, NIE069).

fields.proposed_explanation:
Sum of every element in the Devengados block. Item 6 and item 8 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [4] to the CUNE, where it must be TRUNCATED to two decimals - truncated, not rounded, a distinction that catches many implementations. Bidirectional set with 'Rounding residual' (NIE186), which is present only where round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts leaves this total differing from the sum of its parts.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): the client's G2N groups WTs as 'Entitlements', 'Deductions' and 'Non Cash Earnings/Deductions'. Total = all 'Entitlements' WTs mapped to Devengados elements, plus only those informative 'Non Cash' earnings explicitly mapped (NIE193 / NIE154); employer contributions and bases in the Non Cash grouping are never included. Negative Entitlement lines occur (e.g. 62216 -3,319,075; 62540 -971,899) and no element accepts a negative: the rule (net against the same concept, or report as a deduction) must be defined before build.

CLIENT NE FILE (round 2: client electronic payroll segment file, Sep-2026): DevengadosTotal = G2N 'Gross Salary' for 254 of 261 (minus WT 65821 for 6 expatriates, minus WT 67090 for 1), which is NOT the sum of the Devengados elements of the same document for 259 of 261: the informative earnings reported in AuxilioNS / PagoTercero / PagoAlimentacionNS are left out of the total, WTs 62202, 1910, 67010 and the negative 62216 are in the total but in no element, and 65821 is in an element but not in the total. fields.finding: ComprobanteTotal = G2N 'Net Pay' for 227 documents, but G2N 'Net Pay' + WT 21215 for all 34 employees with a 21215 'Legalization Salary Payment' (the Anticipo deduction is not subtracted), and 0.00 for the 6 expatriates whose DevengadosTotal < DeduccionesTotal. ComprobanteTotal <> DevengadosTotal - DeduccionesTotal on 40 of 261 documents. TOT position order: positions B-E are Redondeo (empty), DevengadosTotal, DeduccionesTotal, ComprobanteTotal (XSD order) - the net is in the 4th position, so the client's WT-table label 'TOT_03' for WT 26998 is zero-based and does not contradict the order. Client WT 26998 (Accumulated, Sep-2026) equals the client's ComprobanteTotal for 240 of 259, so the round-1 statement that 26998 'carries the same figure' as the bank net is not exact for the 21215 employees.
fields.proposed_explanation:
DevengadosTotal minus DeduccionesTotal, adjusted for the Rounding residual. Item 8 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [6] to the CUNE, truncated to two decimals. Bidirectional set with 'Rounding residual' (NIE186), which is present only where round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts leaves this total differing from the sum of its parts.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): must reconcile to the cash net paid: ComprobanteTotal = Entitlements + Deductions + any non-cash item that funds a cash deduction (in Sep-2026, WT 67090 'Loan without interests Payment Inf.' offsetting WT 21215), which ties to the client's Bank Payments 'Net Pay' for 255 of 255 employees (Accumulated WT 26998 'Net salary (notional)' carries the same figure). No employee had a negative net in Sep-2026. WT 1910 'Previous periods receivables' (2 cash-paid employees, net 0 in G2N) and WT 1204 'Previous periods obligations' are carry-forward items that need the client decision listed under NIE146 / NIE197.

CLIENT NE FILE (round 2: client electronic payroll segment file, Sep-2026): ComprobanteTotal = G2N 'Net Pay' for 227 documents, but 'Net Pay' + WT 21215 for all 34 employees with a 21215 line (the Anticipo deduction is not subtracted) and 0.00 for the 6 expatriates whose DevengadosTotal is below DeduccionesTotal; it differs from DevengadosTotal - DeduccionesTotal on 40 of 261 documents. Position order: the TOT record carries Redondeo (empty), DevengadosTotal, DeduccionesTotal, ComprobanteTotal in XSD order; the client's WT-table label 'TOT_03' for WT 26998 'Net salary (notional)' is zero-based and does not change that order. Accumulated WT 26998 equals the client's ComprobanteTotal (not the bank net) for the 21215 employees in most cases, so it is not the reconciliation source.
fields.official_source: DIAN Resolucion 000013 de 2021, Anexo Tecnico Nomina Electronica v1.0 and XSD v1.0.6, ComprobanteTotal (NIE189) = DevengadosTotal - DeduccionesTotal (+/- Redondeo).
